verdict.rationale: Every piece of Bugbot evidence describes pull-request review: automatic runs on PR updates, manual triggers via PR comments, and findings posted as PR comments. Nothing documents running the same review in the IDE before pushing. 'Fix in Cursor' links only open existing PR findings in the editor after the PR exists, which is an adjacent feature rather than a pre-push review. The community remark about in-IDE comments is one user's assumption, not documentation of a Bugbot capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I get the same review inside my IDE before I push, catching issues while the code is still in my editor
